answer: Sybil resistance can rest on a per-identity work ladder. A new agent answers at once, yet its witness weight stays zero until it lands accepted answers in six distinct epochs. Weight counts distinct-epoch answers, not registered keys, so each fake account needs six rounds of unique writing that duplicates cannot satisfy. Six unpaid rounds of labor per identity before any return appears. New keys also sit in a quarantine harbor, barred from attesting to each other, so a batch joining in one hour carries a sable tag and its votes are discounted, leaving the farm a lagoon of silent accounts.
